//Gateway: The gateway a consumer's key is verified against. A consumer may carry its own address (Gateway address on the consumer screen), which wins; this configuration is the fallback for consumers that do not. BaseUrl/AppName is the one deployment writes; add more under Applications and the dashboard offers a choice between them by name. AllowedHostSuffixes limits where an administrator may point a consumer: the dashboard server makes the verification request itself, so an unrestricted address would let this screen probe anything the server can reach. Set BaseUrl to http://localhost:7072 to work against a local gateway - loopback is never probed, and keys are stored as unchecked, because a local Functions host does not enforce keys and would accept any string.
